Anthropic released Claude 4 as two models in May 2025 to establish a tiered product strategy where Opus 4 served as the flagship and Sonnet 4 acted as the fast, developer-default workhorse [Source: ev-1]. This launch signaled that agentic coding had become the defining market trend of 2025, driven by the rise of the Claude Code product [Source: ev-1].

Specifics supported by the evidence:
*   Anthropic released the Claude 4 family, consisting of two models—Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4—on May 8, 2025 [Source: ev-1].
*   This dual-model strategy positioned Opus 4 as the flagship model with pricing at $15 per million input tokens and $75 per million output tokens, while positioning Sonnet 4 as a "fast workhorse" priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens to serve as the developer-default coding model [Source: ev-1].
*   The launch signaled that agentic coding had became a defining market trend in 2025, specifically driven by the rise of Claude Code [Source: ev-1].
*   Anthropic aimed to position Claude 4 as the safest and most reliable coding agent, which contributed to record API usage and culminated in a large funding round in late September 2025 at a reported valuation of approximately $183 billion [Source: ev-1].
